wiki_updates.wiki_text: In April 2025 Gulf and PTT Tank announced they would move forward with Map Ta Phut LNG Terminal 3 (final investment decision), and on 24 June 2025 an extraordinary general meeting of Gulf MTP LNG Terminal Co Ltd (GMTP) approved a total investment not exceeding THB60 billion (~US$1.83 billion). On 1 July 2025 GMTP signed an EPCC (engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning) contract with the PEC-CAZ consortium — South Korea's POSCO E&C (POSCO Eco & Challenge, ~KRW1.5tn / ~US$1.1bn) and Thailand's CAZ — for the terminal superstructure on ~200 rai of reclaimed land. Land-reclamation works completed in March 2025. Superstructure construction was scheduled to begin in Q4 2025, with commercial operations targeted for Q1 2029.

Sources describe an initial LNG-import capacity of at least 5 million tonnes per annum (LNG Prime), expandable to a total of 10.8 mtpa; some outlets (Enerdata, Offshore Energy, Gulf) instead frame the initial regasification capacity as 8 Mt/year expandable to 10.8 Mt/year. GEM records the project as Phase I 5.0 mtpa + Phase II 5.8 mtpa = 10.8 mtpa total. The 10.8 mtpa full-build total is consistent across all sources; the initial-phase figure (5 vs 8 Mt/y) is reported inconsistently and the exact Phase I / Phase II split is not independently stated.

summary: Map Ta Phut LNG Terminal 3 (Gulf 70% / PTT Tank 30%) has moved from proposed to construction on Phase I: FID reached April 2025, THB60bn (~US$1.83bn) investment approved by EGM 24 June 2025, and a firm EPCC contract signed 1 July 2025 with the PEC-CAZ consortium (POSCO E&C + CAZ, ~US$1.1bn) for the terminal superstructure; land reclamation completed March 2025 and superstructure construction was scheduled for Q4 2025 (now ~8 months past). Per the brief, a confirmed EPC award is construction-start evidence, so I staged Phase I Status proposed->construction (green), confirmed ConstructionYear 2025, and appended a construction(actual) Q4 2025 timeline entry rather than punting. Phase II stays proposed (it is the expansion to the 10.8 mtpa total; the project-wide April-2025 FID is confirmed for it, but no separate Phase II construction start is reported). Capacity total 10.8 mtpa is solid; the initial-phase figure is reported inconsistently (5 vs 8 Mt/y) and the 5.0/5.8 phase split is GEM-internal, so I flagged rather than changed capacity. Also flagged two orphan StartDate [ref]s and a likely owner-name typo ('Gulf MPT' -> 'Gulf MTP'). Marine LNG import terminal = in scope. All 8 cited URLs (Gulf primary + LNG Prime, Offshore Energy, Enerdata, KED Global, Kaohoon) passed url_verifier.
